sloka: ततो ऽहं तत्र रामाय पित्रा सत्याभिसन्धिना ।निश्चिता दातुमुद्यम्य जलभाजनमुत्तमम् ॥ २.११८.५०॥
transliteration: tato 'haṁ tatra rāmāya pitrā satyābhisandhinā ।niścitā dātumudyamya jalabhājanamuttamam ॥ 2.118.50॥

translations.english: Then, my father steadfast in truth, held a vessel of pure water and declared his decision to offer me to Rama.
